No model calls, worker checkout changes, completion marker or SUCCESS creation.
"""
import base64
from hashlib import sha256
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import subprocess

from scripts.greenfield import collect_ws32_worker_evidence as collect
from scripts.greenfield.evict_reviewed_local_copies import _leases
from scripts.greenfield.fp8_baseline_guard import census_command, validate_fleet

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
TAG = ROOT.name
PIN = "69b6e1425377ff9af576622670d8f6888e32c669"
LABEL = "128k_d0_95"
REPO = Path("/home/gianl/glm-tpu-topology-rewrite")

DEST = ROOT / "original_collection_20260912T1554Z_resume1"
SOURCE = (REPO / "scripts/greenfield/collect_ws32_worker_evidence.py").read_bytes()
TOPO = Path("/home/gianl/gcs-models/results/greenfield_topology_20260826T194116460015528Z/host_records")
PINS = {rank: sha256((TOPO / f"topology.rank{rank}.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest() for rank in range(8)}


def ssh(command, label, timeout=600):
    p = subprocess.run(["gcloud", "compute", "tpus", "tpu-vm", "ssh", "db-v4-64-od",
        "--zone", "us-central2-b", "--worker=all", "--command=" + command],
        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
    (DEST / (label + ".stdout.txt")).write_text(p.stdout)
    (DEST / (label + ".stderr.txt")).write_text(p.stderr)
    if p.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(f"{label} SSH rc={p.returncode}; original outputs retained")
    return p.stdout


def census(label):
    # Same ordinary process/container checks as the protected wrapper.
    command = '''tools=1; command -v pgrep >/dev/null || tools=0; command -v fuser >/dev/null || tools=0; sudo -n true >/dev/null 2>&1 || tools=0; generic=$(pgrep -af "VLLM::[E]ngineCore|[R]ayWorkerWrapper|[g]lm_longctx[.]py|[r]un_short_decoder_ws32[.]py|[c]ompile_short_decoder[.]py|[m]icrobench_collectives[.]py" || true); holders=$(sudo -n fuser /tmp/libtpu_lockfile 2>/dev/null || true); containers=$(sudo -n docker ps --format "{{.ID}} {{.Image}} {{.Names}} {{.Command}}" 2>/dev/null); docker_rc=$?; if [ "$tools" -ne 1 ] || [ "$docker_rc" -ne 0 ]; then echo "CENSUS_BAD $(hostname)"; elif [ -n "$generic" ] || [ -n "$holders" ] || echo "$containers" | grep -Eqi "[v]llm|[g]emma|[q]wen|[r]erank|[a]spt"; then echo "CENSUS_BUSY $(hostname)"; else echo "CENSUS_OK $(hostname)"; fi'''
    text = ssh(command, label + "_normal", 55)
    hosts = [line.split()[1] for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith("CENSUS_OK ")]
    if len(hosts) != 8 or len(set(hosts)) != 8:
        raise ValueError("ordinary census not eight unique idle hosts")
    root = ssh(census_command(), label + "_root", 55)
    validate_fleet(root)
    print(label + " normal/root8clean", flush=True)


def collection_command(digests=None):
    code = "import base64,socket,sys; rank=int(socket.gethostname().rsplit('-w-',1)[1]); "
    code += "pins=" + repr(PINS) + "; "
    argv = ["collect_ws32_worker_evidence.py", "--tag", TAG, "--code-hash", PIN,
            "--delivery-context-label", LABEL, "--topology-capture-sha256"]
    code += "sys.argv=" + repr(argv) + "+[pins[rank]]; "
    if digests is not None:
        code += "digests=" + repr(digests) + "; sys.argv += ['--publish-inventory-sha256',digests[rank]]; "
    code += "exec(compile(base64.b64decode(" + repr(base64.b64encode(SOURCE).decode()) + "),'<reviewed-collector>','exec'))"
    return shlex.join(["env", "JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu", "PYTHONPATH=" + str(REPO),
                      "/home/gianl/vllm-env/bin/python", "-c", code])


def rows(text):
    # gcloud multiplexes host stdout: complete JSON records can be adjacent
    # without newlines. Preserve the original text and reject any nonspace tail.
    parts = text.split("WS32_COLLECT ")
    if parts[0].strip():
        raise ValueError("unexpected collection stdout prefix")
    values = []
    for part in parts[1:]:
        value, end = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(part)
        if part[end:].strip():
            raise ValueError("unexpected collection stdout tail")
        values.append(value)
    return values


with _leases():
    DEST.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    census("pre")
    original = rows((PREVIOUS / "inventory.stdout.txt").read_text())
    collect.require_fleet_inventories(original, TAG, PIN, delivery_context_label=LABEL)
    print("reusing eight completed original inventories/publication receipts", flush=True)
    published = rows((PREVIOUS / "published.stdout.txt").read_text())
    if len(published) != 8 or {r["rank"] for r in published} != set(range(8)):
        raise ValueError("missing publication receipt")
    for row in published:
        proof = row.pop("published_objects")
        if len(proof) != 18:
            raise ValueError("incomplete primary publication")
    collect.require_fleet_inventories(published, TAG, PIN, delivery_context_label=LABEL)
    if sorted(published, key=lambda r:r["rank"]) != sorted(original, key=lambda r:r["rank"]):
        raise ValueError("publication inventory drifted")
    print("primary publication verified; publishing existing preparation channel", flush=True)
    code = "import socket,sys; from scripts.greenfield.ws32_delivery_phase_transport import main; "
    code += "sys.argv=" + repr(["phase", "--tag", TAG, "--code-hash", PIN, "--context-label", LABEL, "--rank"]) + "+[socket.gethostname().rsplit('-w-',1)[1]]; main()"
    text = ssh(shlex.join(["env", "JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu", "PYTHONPATH="+str(REPO), "/home/gianl/vllm-env/bin/python", "-c", code]), "phases")
    phase_rows = [json.loads(line) for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith('{"files":')]
    if len(phase_rows) != 8 or any(v != dict(files=48, missing=[], numerical_claim=False) for v in phase_rows):
        raise ValueError("incomplete preparation publication")
    census("post")
    print("ORIGINAL_COLLECTION_COMPLETE; no model rerun; seal still required", flush=True)
